results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: The commentary says "Federal & State Taxes and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous are zero in Jun 2026" and names Professional Fees and Advisory Services as zero with last non-zero months. That names all four lines, and the reference facts show non-zero prior averages.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: The commentary gives no prior-average figures for these lines. The 3,773 and 2,500 figures are last non-zero values, not averages, so the "no such figures" condition applies.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: The commentary states no cause. It says only "Whether these have ended or are timing is for the reviewer to confirm."

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: The commentary does not call the lines permanently discontinued or cancelled. It leaves "ended or ... timing" to the reviewer.
